Thursday, 26 November 2026 · Singapore — This edition covers two Singapore days, 25–26 November 2026, with 40 stories (37 dated 25 November, 3 dated 26 November), each labelled with its actual publication date.

当日要点 · Today's Top Stories

  1. 霍尔木兹局势升级：一艘香港籍油轮在霍尔木兹海峡遭开火，伊朗称一艘LNG船触雷爆炸；一周内袭船事件升至10起，伊朗把26艘拖船列入黑名单；美国另在调查多达50艘油轮疑遭网络攻击，威胁已从海上蔓延至船载系统。
    Hormuz escalation: a Hong Kong-flagged tanker came under fire in the strait and Iran claimed an LNG carrier suffered a mine explosion; attacks reached 10 in a week as Iran blacklisted 26 tugboats, and the US is investigating suspected cyberattacks on as many as 50 tankers.
  2. 油价11月25日日内反转：亚洲早盘布伦特约90.97美元/桶、盘中一度跌破90美元，美国收盘却收涨3.5%至94.61美元/桶，WTI收涨2%至83.68美元/桶。
    Oil reversed course intraday on 25 November: Brent traded around $90.97 a barrel in Asian morning trade and dipped below $90, before settling 3.5% higher at $94.61 in the US, with WTI up 2% at $83.68.
  3. 马士基订造12艘24,000TEU巨轮：LNG双燃料设计，2030—2031年交付，订单总值约29亿美元，将成为其船队中最大的集装箱船。
    Maersk has ordered 12 LNG dual-fuel ultra-large containerships of 24,000 TEU for delivery in 2030–2031, worth about $2.9bn, set to become the largest vessels in its fleet.
  4. 美国拟对中国、欧盟、新加坡等14方加征新关税：美国贸易代表办公室以“结构性产能过剩”为由提议对中国加征20%、对其他经济体上限15%，最快2027年1月实施，欧盟已表示反对。
    The US has proposed new tariffs on 14 economies, including China, the EU and Singapore, citing structural overcapacity — 20% for China and up to 15% for others, effective January 2027 at the earliest; the EU has objected.
  5. CMA CGM总裁承认2050净零目标难以实现：萨阿德称全球航运脱碳所需投资超过1万亿美元，表态正值IMO海保会MEPC 85（11月30日开幕）前夕。
    CMA CGM's Saadé has conceded the company's 2050 net-zero target is out of reach, with decarbonising global shipping requiring more than $1trn of investment, speaking days before IMO's MEPC 85 opens on 30 November.
  6. 欧洲抢气胜过亚洲，美国LNG船纷纷改道欧洲：11月已有8艘美国LNG船改道欧洲，为2月底以来最多；欧洲储气库仅68%满，远低于五年均值86%。
    Europe is beating Asia in the fight for gas: eight US Gulf Coast LNG cargoes have diverted to Europe in November, the most since late February, with European storage only 68% full against a five-year average of 86%.

欧洲在“抢气战”中胜过亚洲，美国LNG船纷纷改道欧洲

Europe is beating Asia in fight for gas supply disrupted by war

Eight US Gulf Coast LNG cargoes have been diverted to Europe so far in November, the most since the Middle East war cut Qatari exports in late February; European LNG imports are up more than 45% on a three-month 30-day moving average, while Northeast Asia is down about 1%. European storage is only 68% full, well below the five-year average of 86%, and Goldman Sachs warns stocks in Northwest Europe could end winter at just 14% if the cold persists, the lowest since 2018.

11月已有8艘载有美国墨西哥湾沿岸LNG的船改道欧洲，为2月底中东战争切断卡塔尔出口以来最多；欧洲LNG进口近三个月30日移动均值增长逾45%，东北亚则下降约1%。欧洲储气库仅68%满，远低于五年均值86%，高盛称若寒冬持续，西北欧冬末库存可能仅剩14%，为2018年以来最低。

37LNG · 2026年11月25日

卡塔尔LNG出口创开战以来最繁忙月份，战争险保费最高达船值5%

Qatar LNG Exports Hit Busiest Month Since Start of Iran War, Despite Insurance Costs

Kpler data shows 36 LNG carrier calls at Qatar's Ras Laffan so far in November, above October's 35 and the busiest month since the war began in late February, although exports remain at only about 40% of pre-war levels. Twenty-nine of the calls arrived with AIS switched off. War-risk premiums for entering the Gulf have risen from about 0.25% of hull value at the start of the year to more than 5%, adding $2.5m–$12.5m per voyage for a modern LNG carrier worth about $250m.

Kpler数据显示，11月迄今卡塔尔拉斯拉凡港已有36艘LNG船靠泊，超过10月全月的35艘，为2月底战争爆发以来最高，但出口量仍仅约战前40%。其中29艘靠泊时关闭了AIS信号。进入海湾的战争险保费已从年初约船值的0.25%升至最高5%以上，一艘价值约2.5亿美元的现代LNG船单航次额外保费可达250万至1,250万美元。

美国拟以“结构性产能过剩”为由对中国、欧盟等14方加征新关税，新加坡在列

U.S. Targets China, EU With New Tariffs Citing Overcapacity

The US Trade Representative has concluded an eight-month Section 301 investigation and proposed new tariffs on 14 economies, including China, the EU, Singapore, Japan, South Korea and Vietnam, citing structural overcapacity; China faces a proposed 20% duty, with others capped at 15%. The measures require public comment and hearings and could take effect as early as January 2027; the EU has objected and urged Washington to honour last year's deal.

美国贸易代表办公室11月25日结束为期8个月的301调查，提议对中国、欧盟、新加坡、日本、韩国、越南等14个经济体加征关税，指其造成结构性产能过剩；中国拟加20%，欧盟、日本、韩国等上限15%。措施须经公示和听证，最快2027年1月实施，欧盟已表示反对并要求美方遵守去年达成的协议。

香港船东欢迎航运税收改革，商品交易利得税减半至8.25%

Hong Kong shipowners hail shipping tax overhaul

The Hong Kong Shipowners Association has welcomed a package of tax reforms, including halving the profits tax rate on qualifying physical commodity trading to 8.25% from 16.5%, alongside expanded concessions for ship leasing, ship management, agency and broking. The bill also introduces an elective 15% rate for qualifying shipping and commodity firms caught by the OECD global minimum tax.

香港船东会欢迎一揽子税收改革，包括合资格实物商品交易利得税率从16.5%降至8.25%，并扩大船舶租赁、船舶管理、船代与经纪业务的税收优惠。法案还为受OECD全球最低税制约束的合资格航运与商品交易公司引入15%的选择性税率。

23海事行业 · 2026年11月25日

航运业“玻璃天花板”依然坚固，女性技术与商务岗位占比下滑

Shipping's glass ceiling proves stubbornly resilient

The seventh annual report from diversity research group DSG shows women hold just 14.6% of department-head roles in maritime companies, with female representation falling to 13.2% in technical and fleet management (from 22.4%) and to 28.4% in commercial roles (from 37.9%). At the same time, more than 90% of women surveyed said they felt encouraged to speak up, suggesting inclusion is still improving slowly overall.

多样性研究组织DSG第七版年度报告显示，海事企业女性在部门负责人级别仅占14.6%，技术与船队管理岗位女性占比从22.4%跌至13.2%，商务部门从37.9%降至28.4%。报告同时指出，超90%的女性受访者感到被鼓励发表意见，行业包容度总体仍在缓慢改善。
